summary: A funding plan in the address meets a rival plan from the other chamber that avoids new taxes.
realLife: A governor's address asked for new money for roads and warned that cuts would hurt safety, health and schools. The new speaker of the other party's chamber answered at once with a plan to fund roads by shifting money from business subsidies and a lawmaker said she would not raise taxes. In the same state a senator said the speech skipped public transit.
sources: FOX 2 Detroit (Michigan), 'Michigan State of the State: Lawmakers react to Gov. Whitmer's address', February 26, 2025: https://www.fox2detroit.com/news/michigan-state-state-lawmakers-react-gov-whitmers-address
